column1: # Lane social-profile, wave 27. Partition src/pages/social/** except groups/**
# and src/components/social/** except feed/**.
# ONE FAMILY, TAKEN TO THE BOTTOM. Nine catalogued frames - Followers, Following
# and Holders at 375, 768 and 1440 - are drawn by two mounted files,
# src/components/social/FollowersModal.tsx and src/components/social/HoldersModal.tsx.
# The purpose-built profile/CreatorFollowListModal and profile/CreatorHoldersModal
# have no mount site, so a change there moves no row. Every node below was opened
# first hand through the Plugin API on 2026-09-06 - the modal frame, its controls
# row, its Frame 466 nav block, its list, and the nav's own children - and no
# number here is carried from an earlier row.
# THREE FIXES LANDED, each with its oracle in the same commit and each value
# proved red by an extending mutation that was then restored from a copy:
#   df660a218  sheet height off the list, ceilinged where the frames ceiling
#   a446d401e  the sheet fill and stroke
#   6020def60  the secondary fill on copy the frames do not draw
# All 123 checks in src/components/social/__tests__/creatorListModalSheet.figma.test.ts
# pass, and 546 across __tests__ + profile/. Two failures under
# src/components/social/feed/** during the sweep belong to the social-feed lane's
# uncommitted working tree, not to this change.
# NOTHING IS PROMOTED. Every row keeps partial and names what is still open,
# because each of these frames still has at least one element the file does not
# draw. A fix is not a parity claim.
# THE MEASUREMENT THAT DROVE THE FIRST FIX. One component draws two states and
# the frames size them oppositely:
#   six-row list, sheet hugs it (primaryAxisSizingMode AUTO)
#   fifteen-row list, sheet stops (FIXED, clipsContent true)
# So height is the list's, up to 604 at 375 and 648 from 768. The file held the
# list in a fixed box - 300px in FollowersModal, 350px in HoldersModal - so the
# sheet resolved to one height at every board and every list length: 448 / 450 /
# 454. Against the Followers boards that is 156, 198 and 194px short.
# THE RESIDUAL, STATED RATHER THAN ROUNDED AWAY. Figma draws each rule as a
# zero-height VECTOR carrying a 1px stroke, so its auto-layout allocates 0 where
# CSS must allocate 1. At the six-row state the sheet is now +7 on the frame (two
# nav rules, five row rules) at all three boards. At the ceiling it is exactly
# 604 / 648 / 648, delta 0.00, because the ceiling is stated on the sheet itself.
# WHAT NONE OF THE NINE HAS. The third Suggested tab (Followers and Following
# boards, all three widths) has no server behind it; the tab labels carry counts
# the frame does not draw, which widens the measured 72x22 active chip;
# HoldersModal keeps a Holders / Total Supply block the frame omits; and the 375
# tab strip's gradient fade and chevron are not built. Each is named per row.
# key

column5: FIXED THIS WAVE, three values, each mutation-proved. (1) SHEET HEIGHT. Code after: max-h-[min(85vh,604px)] md:max-h-[min(85vh,648px)] on the sheet, and a bare min-h-0 overflow-y-auto box for the list so it hugs and gives way at the ceiling. Code before: the list sat in a fixed box (ScrollArea h-[300px] / h-[350px]) and the sheet resolved to 448 / 450 / 454 at every list length, capped only by max-h-[85vh] = 690 / 870 / 765. Code after: max-h-[min(85vh,604px)] md:max-h-[min(85vh,648px)] on the sheet, and a bare min-h-0 overflow-y-auto box for the list so it hugs and gives way at the ceiling. At the ceiling the delta is 0.00; at the six-row state it is +7, the seven 1px CSS rules Figma allocates 0 for. A Radix ScrollArea cannot express this - a Root sized by max-height clips without scrolling, because its viewport resolves h-full against an auto-height parent - so the box is a plain overflow container and DialogContent's own overflow-y-auto carries the scroll. (2) SHEET FILL AND STROKE. Figma #122524 under a 1px #123F3C stroke. Code before took both from the primitive: bg-background is hsl(177 100% 4.3%) = #001615, the ground a card sits ON, and border rounds to #12403D through its HSL percentages. Code after pins bg-[#122524] border-[#123f3c]; delta 0 on both. (3) SECONDARY FILL. Every secondary run these sheets draw is #95A09F - placeholder 5120:202098, inactive tab, row sub-line 5120:202410. The empty state and the holder captions used text-muted-foreground = hsl(225 20% 75%) = #B3B9CC, a blue-grey against a sheet whose greys are green. Code after carries text-[#95a09f] with font-mulish text-[12px]/[16px] tracking-[-0.04em]; delta 0. ALSO RE-MEASURED THIS PASS AT DELTA 0, both sides resolved: sheet width 354 / 448 / 796 against max-w-[354px] with w-[calc(100%-21px)], then md:w-[448px], then lg:w-[796px]; radius 16 / 16 / 32 against rounded-[16px] sm:rounded-[16px] lg:rounded-[32px]; padding 24/12 and 24/16 at 1440 against py-6 px-3 sm:py-6 sm:px-3 lg:px-4; overlay #001615 at 0.44 against bg-[#001615]/[0.44]; controls row 18 / 18 / 22 against h-[18px] lg:h-[22px] with itemSpacing 10 against gap-2.5; nav row 32 / 34 / 34 against h-8 md:h-[34px]; tab itemSpacing 24 against gap-6; active chip radius 4, pad 2/8, fill #123F3C and height 20 / 22 / 22 against rounded-[4px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#123f3c] over 14/16 then md:14/18. The frame's shine ellipse is correctly absent: at every board it sits wholly above the sheet's top edge and the sheet clips. Sheet node 11474:217868, 448x456 AUTO over a 308-tall Frame 358; the nav holds ONE tab, Holders, 63x22. STILL OPEN: the file adds a Holders / Total Supply block above the list that no Holders board draws, which costs the list 88px inside the same ceiling; it is kept because both numbers are real, and its ground (#001615) and radius (8) already come off CTA/button 11474:219909. STILL OPEN: the frame's 104x32 / 100x34 / 140x34 Recent control at the nav's right end is deliberately not built - the list is ordered by holding size and the rank column numbers that order, so a time sort would renumber ranks under a heading that no longer describes them.
